scripts.build: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e){} try { require('child_process').execSync('npm --workspace frontend/web run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/web/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true, force:true});} } catch(e){}"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e){}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "node --use-system-ca --watch-path=backend/src --watch-path=backend/shared --watch backend/src/server.js" "cd frontend/web && npm run dev" "cd frontend/admin && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "node --use-system-ca --watch-path=backend/src --watch-path=backend/shared --watch backend/src/server.js" "cd frontend/web && npm run dev" "cd frontend/admin && npm run dev"
